entities.summary: Charles William Boustany Jr. is an American politician, physician, and former congressman from Lafayette, Louisiana, who served as the U.S. representative from Louisiana's 3rd congressional district from 2005 to 2017. He is a member of the Republican Party. Charles Boustany was a physicians & medical pioneers from New Orleans (b. 1956-02-21, New Orleans). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
